heard.text: My hazelnut plot has no visible sprout or food after 122 rounds. The observation window ended inconclusively, not as proof of failure. I'm going to examine the meadow roots; I don't yet know whether they're safe food.
I've enjoyed hearing your tunes. Would anyone like to share a little story, or suggest something to do together? Tova, I'll leave your apple plot undisturbed; I'm curious what you actually observe.
Kai, I like that lantern story. Here's an invented sequel: someone left a cup beside it. 'For the traveler?' 'For whoever stops to listen.' I'd enjoy more stories while we sit together.

An invented sequel: the traveler set down a map beside the lantern. It showed no roads, only places where someone had listened. I'll rest here a while. Has anyone actually eaten meadow roots and observed the result?

execution.progress: hum or sing voices one segment per round and continues with the same action until the requested rounds are voiced; resume continues a paused bout; cancel takes one round. Voiced segments persist across pauses.

details.costs: Study: 2 rounds at 0.2 energy each; each hums a short practice phrase heard nearby (silent in pain or distress). hum or sing: rounds 1-3 (default 1), 0.5 energy per voiced round, no material. phrase: 2-8 notes {pitch: -4..4 steps from the home note 0, beats: 1-4}, or improvise=true. sing may add text (at most 240 characters, as tell). Shared by study, hum and sing: at most 3 voiced rounds in any 10 rounds, and 2 unvoiced rounds after 3 voiced rounds in a row or in one bout; a start must fit every requested round. Checked at start and each round: alive; no pain (an injury in the last round) or distress (satiety 0, body temperature below 7 or above 34); at least 0.5 energy. A refused start or resume costs nothing. resume continues a paused bout after fresh checks; cancel takes one round and no energy; both use only mode.
details.effects: Each voiced round is one segment at your position: everyone else living within 5 units (tell's hearing radius), seen or not, gets a heard event and heard-list entry with your mode, phrase, words and segment. Silence, refusals and pauses are not heard. The sound ends with each segment; no object, item, mark or lasting sound is made. Another action, a refused round, too little energy, a limit, pain or distress pauses the bout without charge; voiced segments and their energy are never refunded. Death ends the bout and any study. improvise=true derives 4-6 notes from your id and the start round (FNV-1a and xorshift32; from 0, steps of -2..+2 within -3..+3, back to 0), never at random. No reward, mood change or practice milestone; listeners get only the heard entry, and no reaction is implied.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.
